name: @groeponline/pi-agent-orchestrator
tagline: Multi-agent orchestration for Pi coding agents: autonomous subagents, parallel worktrees, swarms, schedules, handoffs, budgets, and a live terminal dashboard.

coreCapabilities.title: Interactive TUI dashboard
coreCapabilities.description: inspect agents, queues, schedules, resources, health and performance while work is live.

coreCapabilities.title: Subagent lifecycle
coreCapabilities.description: spawn, queue, steer, stop, inspect and collect structured results.

coreCapabilities.title: Permission inheritance
coreCapabilities.description: child agents can only become more restricted than their parent.

coreCapabilities.title: Worktree isolation
coreCapabilities.description: give implementation agents separate branches and filesystems when parallel writes would collide.

coreCapabilities.title: Persistent scheduling
coreCapabilities.description: cron, interval and one-shot jobs with daemon visibility.

coreCapabilities.title: Structured handoffs
coreCapabilities.description: pass machine-readable state between agents instead of relying on hidden chat context.

coreCapabilities.title: Swarm coordination
coreCapabilities.description: coordinate dynamic membership and completion across several workers.

coreCapabilities.title: Prompt compression profiles
coreCapabilities.description: reduce static system-prompt overhead with global and per-agent profiles.

coreCapabilities.title: Cross-extension RPC
coreCapabilities.description: authenticated peer-extension calls with a strict spawn allowlist and mutation rate limits.

agentTypes.Best for: Fast parallel codebase discovery and evidence gathering
Architecture and implementation planning before edits
Sandboxed data or compute with optional `@groeponline/context-mode`

compressionLevels.Current behavior: Most verbose read-only and handoff guidance
compressionLevels.Recommended use: Smaller or less instruction-reliable models; debugging instruction-following failures; rich structured handoffs

compressionLevels.Current behavior: Concise guidance while retaining examples and field descriptions
Short read-only guidance and a minimal handoff schema
compressionLevels.Recommended use: Short, low-risk tasks with strong models where small prompt savings matter more than protocol detail
